description:
Cast Phyrexian Marauder for {X} = 0.
Phyrexian Marauder dies to having zero toughness.
Yedora triggers, returning it to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Tap that Forest for {G}.
Activate Primordial Mist by exiling the face-down Phyrexian Marauder, and allowing you to cast it this turn.
Repeat.
